entries.question: Which phrase has the OPPOSITE meaning of "go for"?
entries.concept: go for ＝ 支持、選擇；反義為 go against ＝ 反對、違背。
steps: go for an idea：支持一個點子。
go against：與之相反、違背。
pitfalls: 選 turn down：那是 accept 的反義。

entries.question: Which phrase has the OPPOSITE meaning of "accept"?
entries.concept: accept ＝ 接受；反義為 turn down ＝ 拒絕。
steps: turn down an offer：拒絕提議。
選項中其他片語：disagree with 不同意、go against 違背。
pitfalls: 選 disagree with：那是 agree with 的反義。

entries.question: Which phrase has the OPPOSITE meaning of "agree with"?
entries.concept: agree with ＝ 同意；反義為 disagree with ＝ 不同意。
steps: agree with sb：同意某人。
加上字首 dis- 表示相反：disagree with。
pitfalls: 選 go against：語意接近但不是直接反義。

entries.question: Combine the sentences: "It is wrong to make fun of people's appearance. Most students in my class find this wrong."
entries.concept: find + it（虛受詞）+ adj. + to VR：認為做某事是……的。
steps: 真正的受詞 to make fun of people's appearance 太長，移到後面，用 it 先佔位。
it 不能省略，後面要用 to VR。
正解：Most students in my class find it wrong to make fun of people's appearance.
pitfalls: 省略 it，或後面改用 V-ing、加 is。

entries.question: The boss asked all her ______ to work overtime in order to finish the project on time.
entries.concept: 依句意選詞性：老闆要「員工」加班。
steps: employee 員工（受僱者）；employer 雇主。
all her ______ 需要複數名詞：employees。
pitfalls: 和 employers（雇主）混淆。

entries.question: It's not easy these days to find ______ without a university or college degree.
entries.concept: find employment ＝ 找工作；employment 是不可數名詞。
steps: find 後面需要名詞當受詞。
employment（工作、就業）符合句意。
pitfalls: 選 employee：找到「一個員工」不合句意，且可數名詞前需冠詞。

entries.question: Josh is an expert in ______ planning and helps large companies prepare for major projects.
entries.concept: 修飾名詞要用形容詞：corporate ＝ 公司的。
steps: 空格修飾名詞 planning。
corporate (adj.)；corporation (n.) 公司；cooperate (v.) 合作。
pitfalls: 選 corporation：名詞不能直接修飾另一個名詞（此處）。

entries.question: Our flight leaves from ______ 1, so make sure you don't get off the bus at the wrong building.
entries.concept: terminal (n.) ＝ 航廈、總站；(adj.) ＝ 末期的。
steps: flight leaves from Terminal 1：班機從第一航廈出發。
後句 the wrong building 也提示是建築物。
pitfalls: 只記得 terminal「末期的」的意思。

entries.question: When Kurt fell ______, he had to see a doctor and take a whole week off from his job.
entries.concept: fall ill ＝ 生病；fall 在此是連綴動詞，後接形容詞。
steps: ill (adj.) 生病的；illness (n.) 疾病。
連綴動詞（fall、become、get）後接形容詞：fall ill。
pitfalls: 選名詞 illness。

entries.question: A big dog with large white teeth appeared and both cats ran away in ______.
entries.concept: 介系詞後接名詞：in fright ＝ 驚嚇地。
steps: fright (n.) 驚嚇。
frighten (v.)、frightened / frightening (adj.) 都不能直接放在 in 後面。
pitfalls: 選 frightened。

entries.question: During the cold winter months, the family usually turns on a heater or two for a bit of ______.
entries.concept: a bit of + 名詞；warmth ＝ 溫暖（不可數名詞）。
steps: 空格需要名詞。
warm (adj.)、warmly (adv.) 都不是名詞。
pitfalls: 選 warm。

entries.question: After our secretary had contacted the post office via email, a clerk there sent a ______ reply within two hours.
entries.concept: prompt (adj.) ＝ 迅速的、立即的。
steps: 兩小時內就回覆，是「迅速的」回覆：a prompt reply。
frail 虛弱的、drowsy 想睡的、terminal 末期的。
pitfalls: 不熟 prompt 當形容詞的用法。

entries.question: We can deal with everybody's personal opinion later; for now, let's just ______ our discussion to the facts.
entries.concept: confine A to B ＝ 把 A 限制在 B 的範圍內。
steps: 先只討論事實：confine our discussion to the facts。
confide 吐露（秘密）、confirm 確認、contact 聯絡。
pitfalls: 和形近字 confide、confirm 混淆。

entries.question: Princess Mira's diamond earrings ______ under the light of the setting sun.
entries.concept: sparkle (vi.) ＝ 閃耀、閃閃發光。
steps: 鑽石耳環在夕陽下閃閃發亮：sparkled。
stretch 伸展、hesitate 猶豫、confide 吐露，都不合句意。
pitfalls: 只看時態而沒看句意。

entries.question: Mrs. Wang ______ the elastic band over two corners of the lunchbox and handed it to me.
entries.concept: stretch (vt.) ＝ 拉長、撐開。
steps: 把橡皮筋拉開，套在便當盒的兩個角上：stretched。
sparkle 閃耀、frighten 驚嚇、confine 限制，都不合句意。
pitfalls: 誤選 confined（限制）。

entries.question: Most of the class called out the answer to the teacher's question without ______.
entries.concept: without + 名詞：without hesitation ＝ 毫不猶豫地。
steps: 介系詞後接名詞或 V-ing。
hesitation (n.)；hesitate (v.)、hesitant (adj.) 不能直接接在 without 後。
pitfalls: 選 hesitated。

entries.question: Which word best replaces "frail" in "the frail voice called"?
entries.concept: frail ＝ very weak or very sick，可用 weak 替換。
steps: the frail voice：虛弱的聲音。
loud 大聲、angry 生氣、cheerful 開朗，語意都不符。
pitfalls: 只憑上下文猜成 cheerful。

entries.question: The old man's family tried to ______ him ______ by bringing his grandchildren to visit him in the hospital.
entries.concept: cheer sb up ＝ 使某人振作、高興起來。
steps: 家人帶孫子去醫院探望，是為了讓老人開心：cheer him up。
受詞是代名詞時，要放在動詞與副詞中間：cheer him up。
pitfalls: 和 turn down（拒絕）混淆。

entries.question: I ______ leave the house when it started to rain heavily.
entries.concept: be about to + VR ＝ 正要、即將做某事（常與 when 搭配：正要……時，突然……）。
steps: 正要出門時，開始下大雨：I was about to leave... when...
be used to + V-ing 是「習慣於」。
pitfalls: 選 was used to，誤解句意。

entries.question: Don't be too hard on yourself. ______, you're only a beginner.
entries.concept: after all ＝ 畢竟（用來補充理由）。
steps: 別太苛責自己，畢竟你只是初學者。
above all 最重要的是；all in all 總而言之。
pitfalls: 和 all in all 混淆。

entries.question: Volunteering at the animal shelter every weekend really ______ in the lives of the dogs there.
entries.concept: make a difference (in) ＝ 帶來改變、有影響。
steps: 每週末去收容所當志工，讓那裡狗狗的生活有所改變。
主詞是動名詞片語（單數），動詞用 makes。
pitfalls: 選 cheers up：後面接 in the lives 不通。

entries.question: Which sentence uses "pass away" correctly?
entries.concept: pass away ＝ 過世，不及物，後面不接受詞。
steps: The famous singer passed away at the age of 90.：正確。
pass the salt 才是「遞鹽」，不能加 away。
pitfalls: 把 pass away 當成「傳遞」或「通過」。

entries.question: Teachers find it unacceptable ______ students to cheat on tests.
entries.concept: It is + adj. + for sb + to VR：某人做某事是……的。
steps: find it unacceptable for students to cheat：認為學生作弊是無法接受的。
要指出「誰」的行為，用 for + sb。
pitfalls: 選 of：It is kind of you... 這類句型的形容詞是在描述人的特質。

entries.question: Olivia considers ______ bad manners to be late for a date.
entries.concept: consider + it（虛受詞）+ N + to VR。
steps: 真正的受詞 to be late for a date 移到後面，用 it 佔位。
Olivia considers it bad manners to be late for a date.
pitfalls: 選 that 或 what。

entries.question: 【多選題】According to the story, which of the following are true?
entries.concept: 多選閱讀題：每個選項都要回文章確認。
steps: (A)(B)(D)(E) 都與故事內容相符。
(C) 錯：敘事者一開始拒絕擁抱，後來看到 Billy 眼中的期盼才破例，不是一見面就擁抱。
pitfalls: 只記得「有擁抱」，忽略發生的時間點。

entries.question: 【多選題】Which expressions show AGREEMENT (not partial agreement) according to the Listening Strategy?
entries.concept: 區分「完全同意」、「部分同意」、「不同意」的說法。
steps: (A) I agree with you.、(B) That's exactly what I think.、(C) I couldn't agree with you more.：完全同意。
(D) That may be true, but...：部分同意。(E) I don't think so.：不同意。
pitfalls: 誤以為 I couldn't agree more 是否定。

entries.question: 【多選題】Which words are NOUNS as they are used in the lesson?
entries.concept: 從字尾判斷詞性：-ter、-th 常為名詞。
steps: (A) laughter 笑聲、(B) warmth 溫暖、(D) germ 病菌：名詞。
(C) drowsy 昏昏欲睡的、(E) frail 虛弱的：形容詞。
pitfalls: 把 germ 誤為形容詞。
